## Overview

This 2026-09-16 snapshot is the Braintree JavaScript v3 client-side route for Samsung Pay. Its retained body does not provide a client implementation; it says Samsung Pay and this guide are deprecated and directs readers to the Pay Later offers guide instead. The redirect is not evidence that Pay Later is technically equivalent to Samsung Pay or that it supplies a Samsung Pay migration procedure. See [[braintree]] and [[braintree-payment-methods]].

## Key takeaways

- The exact retained route is `/docs/guides/samsung-pay/client-side/javascript/v3/`, titled `Client-Side Implementation`.
- The page explicitly states that Samsung Pay has been deprecated and separately marks the guide deprecated.
- The only next route in the body is the Pay Later offers guide. This is navigation to a distinct guide, not JavaScript v3 setup, replacement API behavior, or lifecycle evidence.
- No client initialization, tokenization, nonce handoff, authorization, capture, settlement, environment, eligibility, or account-enablement procedure appears in the retained body. The snapshot therefore does not establish current availability, SDK or GitHub implementation, a working migration, or payment execution.
